description: This Java class, ConnectionLifecycleWrapper, is an abstract wrapper implementation that delegates all method calls of the ConnectionLifecycle interface to a specified delegate instance. It acts as a base class for extending connection lifecycle behavior with additional logic.

classes.name: ConnectionLifecycleWrapper
classes.description: An abstract class that wraps a ConnectionLifecycle instance, delegating all method calls to it, allowing subclasses to override or extend behavior.

methods.name: ConnectionLifecycleWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with a delegate ConnectionLifecycle instance.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Delegates the connect call to the underlying ConnectionLifecycle delegate.

methods.name: addDisconnectListener
methods.description: Adds a disconnect listener by delegating to the underlying connection.

methods.name: addReconnectListener
methods.description: Adds a reconnect listener via the delegate.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active, delegating to the delegate.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active, with a timeout, delegating to the delegate.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the connection by delegating to the delegate.

methods.description: Disconnects with a completion handler, delegating to the delegate.
